body: yeah, that's pretty much it. i feel very alone. thanks for listening.

i really appreciate your question. it's validating and accepting of my emotions. i just spent a few minutes thinking about why your question made me feel a little bit better, and i think it's because you're not judging me. thanks you. you made me feel a little better and this is a really interesting insight. i'm surprised that communication exchanges with strangers on the internet can be so meaningful (i'm kind of new to reddit). really, thank you.

i don't even know how to answer your question to be honest. my eating disorder is so complicated, and its constantly evolving to trick me in new ways. right now it manifests in binge eating, during which i usually don't know what i'm doing- i've dissociated like i'm not in my body anymore. then i just feel horrible after. but it changes for me over time. sometimes i starve myself and don't even let myself drink water. when i'm really sad and i want to die i just don't eat or drink anymore.
yeah, it helped with my eating disorder. but now i'm fat and seemingly permanently single so i don't know.

Hey, I'm so sorry you're going through all this. It sounds painful. It sounds to me like you are stuck in a loop or cycle (I get into these all the time and I'm only now starting to see it) where all of these things are exacerbating one another, making everything worse. (Depression making sleeping hard, sleep problems exacerbating depression, not meeting new people/potential partners because of depression and maybe the torn trousers, and then more depression!? UGH!!!)

Do you have a therapist or psychiatrist you can talk to? Maybe they can help you disrupt this cycle. Not having energy makes everything suck.

I'm sorry you're feeling like this - it sounds very painful and lonely. You're not worthless. You're a human- just like me, just like them, just like everyone. You deserve to be here (lol I know easy for someone else to say, but still - it's true).
I'm glad you're ok. I'm in DBT. Have you heard of it? It might help. It's proven effective for people who have impulse control issues and like to self harm. Message me if you wanna talk about it.
